title: Fix Store Center Reject Return Propagation Bug
summary_context: Fixed a bug in Store Center Hub where Rejecting a Return didn't propagate to future months, causing inconsistent deltas. Implemented requirement propagation in Decisions API and documented the resolution as ERR-021.
achievements: Implemented required_qty propagation for REJECT_RETURN in Decisions API.
Ensured data consistency across the Asset Plan timeline for future months.
Resolved 'phantom' return request bug in Store Center Hub.

History.result: Applied propagation logic to POST and DELETE handlers
Verified DB structure and code with grep
